title: Fix discovery API endpoint routing and protocol consistency issues
body:
Fixes discovery API endpoint routing across all framework adapters, unifies protocol schemas, and improves client type safety.

## P0 - Discovery route consistency

- All adapters (Express, Fastify, Hono, NestJS, Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit) now mount the discovery endpoint at `{prefix}/discovery` instead of `{prefix}` root
- `.well-known/objectstack` redirects now point to `{prefix}/discovery`
- Client `connect()` fallback URL changed from `/api/v1` to `/api/v1/discovery`
- Runtime dispatcher handles both `/discovery` (standard) and `/` (legacy) for backward compatibility

## P1 - Schema & route alignment

- Added `storage` (service: `file-storage`) and `feed` (service: `data`) routes to `DEFAULT_DISPATCHER_ROUTES`
- Added `feed` and `discovery` fields to `ApiRoutesSchema`
- Unified `GetDiscoveryResponseSchema` with `DiscoverySchema` as single source of truth via `.partial().required({ version: true })` with backward-compatible `apiName` alias
- Client `getRoute('feed')` fallback updated from `/api/v1/data` to `/api/v1/feed`

## P2 - Type safety

- Extracted `ApiRouteType` from `ApiRoutes` schema keys for type-safe client route resolution
- Added `discovery` and `graphql` to client fallback route map
- Removed `as any` type casting in client `getRoute()` method

## Tests

- Updated `discovery.test.ts` for new `ApiRoutesSchema` fields (`feed`, `discovery`)
- Updated `protocol.test.ts` for unified `GetDiscoveryResponseSchema` (hierarchical capabilities, backward compat with `apiName`, full DiscoverySchema-compatible responses)
- Updated `dispatcher.test.ts` for new `storage` and `feed` routes
- Updated `http-dispatcher.root.test.ts` for `/discovery` endpoint handling
- Updated NestJS adapter tests for new `.well-known` redirect target
- All 6,723 spec tests, 62 client tests, and 57 NestJS adapter tests pass

## Documentation

- Added changeset entry (`.changeset/discovery-route-consistency.md`)
- CodeQL security scan: 0 alerts
